mechanism_narrative: The downward momentum in RETAIL_REC itself, evidenced by the last weekly mean being more negative than the four-week average, will persist over the next two weeks as behavioral inertia and ongoing restrictions continue to suppress retail and recreation visits.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than or equal to the last 14 days in more than 50% of instances where the last weekly mean is more negative than the four-week average.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp week-on-week drop in PARKS exceeding 4 points signals heightened caution and reduced outdoor mobility, which spills over into lower retail and recreation footfall over the following two weeks.
failure_condition: When PARKS falls more than 4 points week-on-week, RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is not lower than the previous 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: The simultaneous decline of TRANSIT and WORKPLACES indicates a coordinated reduction in commuting and public mobility, which amplifies the drop in retail and recreation visits over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: When both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES decline, RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days does not decline further.

mechanism_narrative: In a second-wave onset regime, a rise in RESIDENTIAL above 14.0 percent change from baseline indicates people are increasingly staying home, predicting a further decline in RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks as non-essential outings are avoided.
failure_condition: When RESIDENTIAL exceeds 14.0, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not lower than the previous 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A week-on-week drop in GROCERY_PHARM greater than 3 points reflects increased infection fear even for essential trips, which leads to a decline in RETAIL_REC over the following week as discretionary outings are curtailed.
failure_condition: When GROCERY_PHARM falls more than 3 points week-on-week, RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is not lower than the previous 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in WORKPLACES below -48.0 signals that work-from-home mandates or recommendations are in effect, reducing weekday retail footfall and driving RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: When WORKPLACES is below -48.0, RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is not lower than the previous 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline of PARKS and TRANSIT indicates that people are reducing both outdoor leisure and public transit use, which strongly predicts a drop in RETAIL_REC over the following week.
failure_condition: When both PARKS and TRANSIT decline, RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days does not decline further.

mechanism_narrative: Seasonal cooling in late October reduces PARKS visits as people spend more time indoors, shifting activity toward indoor retail and recreation and driving RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: When PARKS declines due to seasonal cooling, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than the previous 28 days.
